after watching episode 7 (“the bridge”), here’s my predicted death ranking for the finale — and hear me out, this lines up with what we just saw:1. kali – her whole arc this season has been emotionally heavy and tied to eleven’s choices. she’s basically pitching a suicide‑style plan with el to collapse the bridge forever, so her story feels like it’s heading for a tragic end. 2. eleven – she’s the core, but episode 7 ends with her maybe agreeing with kali’s plan. that hesitation feels like setup for huge risk — she might stay behind. 3. will – he’s emotionally connected and the group’s moral center now that he’s accepted himself publicly, but vecna’s been targeting him personally before, and his connection to the bridge makes him a real target.4. steve – out front in the group’s plan, right in the danger zone. his death would hit hard emotionally, especially because of his bond with dustin—he’s been mentoring and protecting him all season, and dustin would feel that loss deeply.5. hopper – protective figure to eleven and emotional anchor for the group; his survival is uncertain, especially if the story puts him in a sacrificial role to save eleven.6. holly – pulled around the upside down, nearly captured multiple times, and trapped in vecna’s lair, her situation is extremely precarious. one wrong move and she could be gone in an instant.7. dustin – usually clever and resourceful, but episode 7 puts him in constant danger. with monsters on the move and steve possibly sacrificing himself, dustin could face life-or-death situations that test his limits.let’s see who actually makes it! like this comment after the finale if my predictions are right—or roast me if they’re wrong.p.s. i think most of the characters in top 5 wouldn't make it.
